package twtest

// This standalone suite runs its steps here: lib/standalone logs in to the devices of inventory.yaml
// (SSH, Telnet), sends REST requests, SNMP and NETCONF, drives a browser with Playwright and parses
// output with templates/. Passwords: TW_PASSWORD_<NAME> or TW_PASSWORD (see inventory.yaml).

import (
	"context"
	"encoding/json"
	"os"
	"path/filepath"
	"sync"

	"termwright-tests/lib/standalone"
)

var (
	engOnce sync.Once
	eng     *standalone.Engine
	engErr  error
)

func init() {
	LocalStep = func(step map[string]any) ([]byte, error) {
		engOnce.Do(func() {
			root, _ := os.Getwd()
			for d := root; ; d = filepath.Dir(d) {
				if _, err := os.Stat(filepath.Join(d, "inventory.yaml")); err == nil {
					root = d
					break
				}
				if filepath.Dir(d) == d {
					break
				}
			}
			eng, engErr = standalone.Open(root)
			if eng != nil {
				eng.Ask = standalone.AskTerminal
			}
		})
		if engErr != nil {
			return nil, engErr
		}
		b, _ := json.Marshal(step)
		return json.Marshal(eng.Execute(context.Background(), b))
	}
}
